appName: ထွယ်ဂျီဂွမ်Caculator
tagline: A little clarity. A better tomorrow.
madeFor: Made for E-9 workers in Korea
heroSub: Make sense of your severance pay, one simple step at a time. Clear calculations for your next chapter.
calculatorSub: A few details now. A clearer picture ahead.
planHelp: Not sure which plan you have?
employmentSub: Use the dates for one continuous period with the same employer.
lastDayHelp: Enter the last day you worked. We’ll handle the retirement date.
hoursHelp: Your regular contracted hours, averaged over four weeks.
specialHelp: For example: leave affecting the calculation, a prior settlement, a plan change, or changing weekly hours.
wagesTitle: A closer look at your wages
periodsChanged: Your employment dates changed. Matching wage periods keep their entries; enter amounts again for changed periods and check any annual wage details.
wagesSub: Enter actual gross earnings for each period shown, including partial months. Keep annual bonuses and eligible leave pay in the separate fields below.
annualBonus: Eligible bonuses in the previous 12 months
bonusHelp: Only wage-type bonuses; don’t include these again in the period rows. One quarter is included in the reference wages.
leaveHelp: Enter qualifying leave pay attributable to the prior year. Payments newly arising from this retirement are excluded. One quarter is included.
ordinaryHelp: Find this on a verified payroll calculation. If unknown, the estimate is provisional because ordinary wage may be higher.
positiveOrdinary: Enter a positive daily ordinary wage, or leave it blank if unknown.
dcHelp: Enter all gross wage earnings for each year or partial year shown. Include wage-type bonuses and allowances.
balanceHelp: Optional. Your account balance is shown separately; investment gains or losses do not establish a contribution shortfall.
reviewSub: Check the details below. Your estimate will be calculated using the official reference rules.
placeholderTitle:
Your next chapter,
a little clearer.
placeholderSub: Your estimate and a transparent breakdown will appear here.
rounding: Whole-won display rounded down once, after calculation.
reviewResultSub: This calculator covers standard cases. Use the official sources below to get guidance for your situation.
ineligibleSub: The entered employment does not meet the standard statutory eligibility conditions.

reasons.SERVICE_UNDER_ONE_YEAR: Continuous service is less than one calendar year.
reasons.SPECIAL_CIRCUMSTANCES: Your employment history needs special calculation adjustments.
reasons.HISTORICAL_EMPLOYMENT: Employment beginning before 2013 needs a historical-rules review.
reasons.ZERO_WAGES: A zero wage total needs a payroll review.
reasons.ORDINARY_WAGE_UNKNOWN: Daily ordinary wage was not provided. The actual baseline may be higher.
reasons.DB_BASELINE_ONLY: This is a DB statutory baseline; your employer’s plan may provide more.
reasons.DC_BALANCE_SEPARATE: Required contributions and reported account balance are different measures.

privacySub: No account. No saved salary history. Your inputs are used only for this calculation.
offline: You’re offline. Guides are available; reconnect to calculate.
error: We couldn’t complete the request. Your entries are still here. Check your connection and try again.
invalid: Check the highlighted fields and entered amounts.
dateOrder: The last working day must be on or after the first working day.
invalidDate: Enter a valid date between 1900 and 2100.
invalidMoney: Enter a non-negative amount using digits and an optional decimal point.
balanceDateRequired: Add a valid statement date for your reported balance.
guideSub: Three plans. Different ways of calculating what comes next.
normalGuide: Standard severance uses the applicable daily wage, 30 days, and your length of service. The last three calendar months of actual wages form the reference period.
dbGuide: A defined benefit pension has a wage-and-service baseline. Your employer operates the fund, and its plan may provide benefits above the statutory baseline.
dcGuide: A defined contribution pension is funded through employer contributions of at least one twelfth of eligible annual wages. Your final account balance also reflects investment performance.
eligibilityGuide: Standard statutory eligibility requires at least one year of continuous service and scheduled hours averaging at least 15 per week over four weeks. Special histories need individual review.
insuranceTitle: A little clarity on E-9 insurance
insuranceSub: Departure guarantee insurance is part of understanding your retirement arrangements.
insuranceBody: Employers arrange departure guarantee insurance for eligible foreign workers. An insurance balance and a retirement benefit calculation are not automatically separate amounts to add together.
insuranceBody2: This calculator shows your selected plan’s estimate. Check your actual insurance records through EPS and confirm any reconciliation with the relevant provider or employment office.
footer: A clearer path for workers in Korea.
update: An updated app is ready. Your current entries will remain until you choose to reload.
